test_title: PYST 27: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A sum of money was lent on simple interest. After 7 years it’s simple interest became (7)/(10) of it. Find the rate of interest per annum.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal amount = P (not given explicitly).

Simple interest after 7 years = (7/10) × P.

Time = 7 years.

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = Principal × Rate × Time / 100.

**Calculation:**

Simple Interest = (7/10) × P.

⇒ (7/10) × P = (P × Rate × 7) / 100

⇒ (7/10) = (Rate × 7) / 100

⇒ 7 × 100 = 10 × Rate × 7

⇒ 700 = 70 × Rate

⇒ Rate = 700 / 70

⇒ Rate = 10%

**The rate of interest per annum is 10% (option 1).**
